# Local SEO and Proof

Load `seo-audit` and `ai-seo`; use current search/GBP policy sources.

One route registry drives pages, navigation, metadata, canonicals, sitemap, robots, and redirects. Business claims require provenance. Every customer receives the same optional public review path. GBP changes require owner access and approval. Test linked routes, structured data, 404 metadata, duplicate canonicals, review equality, and claim evidence.
